blocks.text: 1. Hydrogen cyanide (H-CN) ka addition

Aldehydes aur ketones hydrogen cyanide se react kar ke cyanohydrins banate hain. HCN ko seedha istemal nahi karte kyun ke yeh intehai zehreeli (extremely poisonous) gas hai. Is ki jagah sodium cyanide ya potassium cyanide ke aqueous solution aur carbonyl compound ke mixture mein dheere dheere mineral acid (HCl) dala jata hai, aur HCN wahin ban jati hai.
2-Hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile Perspex banane mein darmiyani madda (intermediate) hai. Perspex aik bohat umda rangeen sheeshe jaisa polymer hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer ke caption mein '2-Hydroxy-2-ethylpropanenitrile' likha hai. Propanone aur HCN se banne wala compound, (CH₃)₂C(OH)CN, 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile hai; is mein ethyl nahi, do methyl groups hain.

blocks.alt: Ethanal (C par H3C aur H, C=O; C +delta, O -delta) + H-CN (H +delta, CN -delta), teer ke oopar KCN/HCl, se 2-hydroxypropanenitrile: aik C jis par H3C, OH, H aur CN.
blocks.caption: Ethanal aur HCN se 2-hydroxypropanenitrile (kitab ke PDF safha 104 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Propanone (C=O wale C par do H3C; C +delta, O -delta) + H-CN, teer ke oopar KCN/HCl, se 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile: aik C jis par do H3C, OH aur CN.
blocks.caption: Propanone aur HCN se 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile (kitab ke PDF safha 105 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono reactions mein CN group carbonyl carbon se jur jata hai aur oxygen OH ban jata hai, is liye product mein aik hi carbon par OH aur CN dono hote hain; aise compound ko cyanohydrin kehte hain. Ethanal se 2-hydroxypropanenitrile aur propanone se 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile banta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne propanone wale product ka naam '2-hydroxy-2-methlypropanenitrile' chhapa hai; sahi spelling 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile hai.
Mechanism (reaction ka tareeqa)

HCN, KCN aur carbonyl compound ke mixture mein naap kar (controlled amount) acid dal kar banayi jati hai: KCN aur HCl ke reaction se HCN banti hai. HCN khud na nucleophile hai (carbon atom par lone pair nahi) aur na itna strong acid ke kafi ionize ho. Is liye yeh itne nucleophile (CN⁻) nahi deti ke reaction shuru ho aur jaldi mukammal ho. Is ka hal yeh hai ke KCN thori zyada (slight excess) dali jaye, taa ke solution mein kuch azad CN⁻ ions maujood rahen. Yeh azad ions reaction shuru karte hain aur catalyst ki tarah use munasib raftaar se chalate hain.
Is tarah,

blocks.alt: Teen qadam. i) KCN (Excess) + HCl (Limiting) -> HCN (Nucleophilic Reagent) + KCl. ii) RHC=O (C +delta, O -delta) + cyanide ion :C≡N (manfi charge) equilibrium mein anion ke saath: aik carbon par R, H, O- aur C≡N. iii) Yeh anion + H-CN (H +delta, CN -delta) equilibrium mein hydroxyalkanenitrile (O- ki jagah OH) + cyanide ion ke saath.
blocks.caption: HCN ke addition ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 105 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Qadam (i): thori zyada (excess) KCN aur kam (limiting) HCl se HCN banti hai aur kuch azad CN⁻ ions bach jate hain. Qadam (ii): CN⁻ ka lone pair δ⁺ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai, π bond ke electrons oxygen par chale jate hain aur O⁻ wala anion banta hai. Qadam (iii): yeh anion HCN se H⁺ le kar hydroxyalkanenitrile banata hai aur CN⁻ wapas mil jata hai, jo agle molecule par hamla karta hai. Dono qadam ulat sakte hain (reversible), is liye equilibrium ke teer hain.

Cyanohydrin banne ke dono qadam reversible (ulat sakne wale) hain, phir bhi equilibrium bohat zyada daen taraf hai, is liye zyada tar carbonyl compounds equilibrium par cyanohydrins ki achhi miqdar (high yield) dete hain. Nitriles dilute acid ya aqueous alkali se hydrolyse ho kar carboxylic acids ya carboxylate ions dete hain; yeh aage (23.4.1) aayega.
2. Hydride ion (H⁻) ka addition

Aldehydes aur ketones alcohols ki oxidation se bante hain, is liye in ki reduction se wapas alcohols ban sakte hain. NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ jaise reducing agent se aldehydes primary alcohols aur ketones secondary alcohols dete hain.
Dhyan dein: brackets mein likha reducing H, yani [H], NaBH₄ se aata hai aur sirf equation balance karne ke liye likha jata hai. Is ka matlab atomic hydrogen nahi.

blocks.alt: Do mua'adle. Ethanal, CH3-C(=O)-H, + 2[H], teer ke oopar NaBH4 aur delta (garmi), neeche H2O/OH-, se ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH. Propanone, CH3-C(=O)-CH3, + 2[H], oopar NaBH4 Heat, neeche alkaline aqueous solution, se propan-2-ol, CH3-CH(OH)-CH3.
blocks.caption: NaBH4 se ethanal aur propanone ki reduction (kitab ke PDF safha 105 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aldehyde (ethanal) se primary alcohol (ethanol) aur ketone (propanone) se secondary alcohol (propan-2-ol) banta hai. Har equation mein 2[H] lagta hai, jo NaBH₄ deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne propanone wali equation mein 'alkalineaqucoussolution' aur product ka naam 'propane-2-ol' chhapa hai; sahi 'alkaline aqueous solution' aur propan-2-ol hain.
Mechanism (reaction ka tareeqa)

blocks.alt: Hydride ion H:- (nucleophile) RHC=O (C +delta, O -delta; carbonyl compound) ke carbon par hamla karta hai: aik mura teer (curly arrow) hydride ke lone pair se C tak, doosra C=O bond se O tak. Is se alkoxide ion R-CH2-O- banta hai. Agle teer par H-OH (H +delta, OH -delta) ke saath alcohol R-CH2-OH + :OH- bante hain.
blocks.caption: Hydride ion se carbonyl compound ki reduction ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 106 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hydride ion (H⁻) nucleophile hai. Yeh δ⁺ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai aur C=O ke π electrons oxygen par chale jate hain, is tarah alkoxide ion (O⁻ wala) banta hai. Phir alkoxide ion paani (H–OH) se H⁺ le kar alcohol ban jata hai aur OH⁻ bach jata hai.
3. 2,4-Dinitrophenylhydrazine ka addition (addition-elimination / condensation reaction)

Aldehydes ya ketones 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH) ke saath condensation reaction (do molecules jur kar chhota molecule, yahan paani, nikalna) karte hain aur narangi (orange) crystalline solids dete hain jin ke melting points bilkul wazeh (well-defined) hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is reagent ka mukhtasar naam '2,4-NDPH' likhti hai; sahi mukhtasar naam 2,4-DNPH hai.

blocks.alt: Ethanal (C=O par H3C aur H) + H2N-NH- jo benzene ring se jura hai, saamne NO2 aur saath O2N (2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine) -> ethanal-2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone, jis mein C=O ab C=N-NH- ban gaya, + H2O. Do qataron mein: pehle reactants, phir products.
blocks.caption: Ethanal aur 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine se ethanal-2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone aur paani (kitab ke PDF safha 106 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: C=O ka oxygen aur hydrazine ke NH₂ ke do H mil kar paani (H₂O) ban kar nikal jate hain, aur carbon ab nitrogen se double bond (C=N) bana leta hai. Pehle addition hota hai, phir paani nikalta hai (elimination); isi liye ise addition-elimination ya condensation reaction kehte hain. Ring par NO₂ groups positions 2 aur 4 par hain.

Yeh reagent carbonyl compounds ki pehchan (identification) mein istemal hota hai. Maslan ethanal 2,4-DNPH se react kar ke 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone ke narangi crystals banata hai. Doosri organic classes, jaise carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides aur amides, jin mein carbonyl group >C=O hota hai, yeh test nahi detin.

blocks.alt: Do test tubes: aik mein peela-narangi maaya, doosri narangi qalmon (crystals) se bhari.
blocks.caption: Figure 23.2: Ethanal 2,4-DNPH ke saath narangi qalmi thos deta hai (kitab ki Figure 23.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: KCN ki maujoodgi mein propanone aur HCN ke reaction se kya banta hai, aur KCN kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: 2-Hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, (CH₃)₂C(OH)CN, banta hai. KCN azad CN⁻ ions, yani nucleophile, deta hai; akeli HCN bohat kam CN⁻ deti hai, is liye reaction bohat aahista hota.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: HCN (KCN + HCl se) C=O par jurti hai: cyanohydrins (hydroxynitriles); excess KCN se azad CN⁻ reaction chalata hai.
NaBH₄/LiAlH₄ (hydride ion): aldehyde → primary alcohol, ketone → secondary alcohol.
2,4-DNPH: aldehydes aur ketones narangi crystals dete hain; acids, esters, amides nahi.
